description_en: Call the DescribeSiteMonitorLog operation to query the detection logs for a one-time detection task
description_zh: 调用DescribeSiteMonitorLog接口查询一次性探测任务的探测日志
name: DescribeSiteMonitorLog

parameters.help_en: The ID of the detection task. You can specify multiple task IDs. Separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 探测任务ID。多个探测任务ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: task_ids

parameters.help_en:
The metric.

Only the `ProbeLog` metric is supported
parameters.help_zh:
监控项。

目前仅支持监控项`ProbeLog`
parameters.name: metric_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The following formats are supported: UNIX timestamp: the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970. UTC format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ. The start time and end time follow the (StartTime, EndTime] pattern. The value of StartTime cannot be the same as or later than the value of EndTime.
- Use UNIX timestamps to prevent time zone-related issues.
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间。支持的格式：

UNIX时间戳：从1970年01月01日开始所经过的毫秒数。
UTC格式：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。

开始时间和结束时间遵循左开右闭模式，StartTime不能等于或大于EndTime。                                                                                                                   
    - 建议您使用UNIX时间戳，避免时区问题
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The following formats are supported:

UNIX timestamp: the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970.

UTC format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ.

Use UNIX timestamps to prevent time zone-related issues
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。支持的格式：

UNIX时间戳：从1970年01月01日开始所经过的毫秒数。
UTC格式：YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。

建议您使用UNIX时间戳，避免时区问题
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: If the response is truncated, use the `NextToken` parameter to retrieve the next page of results
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 1440
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的记录条数，用于分页查询。取值范围：1~1440
parameters.name: length

parameters.help_en:
The filter expression for detection results.

Simple expressions are supported. For example, you can use the `TotalTime>100` expression to query the detection data whose total response time exceeds 100 milliseconds
parameters.help_zh:
过滤探测值。

支持简单的表达式，例如：`TotalTime>100`，表示过滤出总响应时间超过100毫秒的探测数据
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: This parameter is deprecated. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 该参数已废弃，无需关注
parameters.name: browser_info

parameters.help_en: The type of the device. This parameter specifies the screen size for impersonation
parameters.help_zh: 设备类型（模拟屏幕大小类型）
parameters.name: device

Code.description_en:
The status code.

A status code of 200 indicates that the operation was successful

Data.description_en: The detection logs of the one-time detection task
Data.description_zh: 一次性探测任务的探测日志

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
